launches.title: Human Archive: Large-Scale multimodal datasets for robotics and world modeling
launches.tagline: Let's archive the world for embodied intelligence
launches.detail_body:
**TL;DR:** We’re capturing the structure of how humans interact with the physical world to model sensorimotor intelligence at scale\
**Launch Video:** <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFHr3GlTpck>

**The Problem:**

Modern AI is largely a knowledge transfer problem. Over the past decade, training on trillions of tokens of internet data enabled breakthroughs in LLMs, diffusion models, and vision-language models. But **human intelligence is predominantly embodied**, and the **internet does not capture it**. Every day we manipulate objects, apply force, and subconsciously adapt in noisy real-world environments. Yet there is no dataset that captures the **structure of human interaction with the physical world at scale**. As a result, progress in \*\*embodied spatial intelligence is bottlenecked by data.\*\*\
\
**What we built:**

Over the past two months, we built infrastructure for high-quality data collection at scale, including:

* Custom hardware rigs
* Internal models for policy benchmarking
* QA pipelines, alignment, and annotation software
* 25-person operations team
* Dedicated servers at our AWS data center for terabyte-scale offloading

Now that the system is live, we can collect **up to 8,000 hours of data per day** and we’ve signed national level partnerships to scale our contributor network to **50,000+ people.** We’ve already shipped datasets to frontier research teams, and have built the largest multimodal dataset of it’s kind.

**Our datasets:**

We are currently collecting data across **homes, restaurants, hotels, retail, transportation, construction, horticulture, and industrial environments** across two datasets. \
\
**HA-Multi** is a fully aligned multimodal dataset with **vision, stereo depth (IR dot projection), tactile gloves, body IMUs, and wrist cameras**. For customers, we provide structured outputs and visualizations including **3D MANO hand reconstructions, 2D tactile force maps, depth maps per timestamp, and human pose reconstructions**. \
\
**HA-Ego** is a **mono RGB vision** and **wrist cameras** dataset. \
\
We provide **annotations** and **metadata** including **environment and scene descriptions, high-level task descriptions, task-aligned atomic action labels, hand tracking, object segmentation, SLAM (extrinsic** and **intrinsics),** and **3D pose reconstruction**.

**Team:**

Hi, we’re Shloke, Samay, Rushil, and Raj. We’re engineers from Stanford and Berkeley who’ve spent our entire lives building across operations, hardware, and robotics. We’ve known each other for over 20 years and joined forces to dedicate the rest of our lives to building the Common Crawl for human sensorimotor intelligence.

**Our Ask**

We'd love to talk with you if:

* You’re building in **robotics, world models, or evaluations**
* You work at or with frontier AI labs interested real world
* You know cleaning companies, hotel chains, restaurants, factories, or other businesses interested in scaling efficiency and profits with AI

👉 Contact us at [raj@humanarchive.ai](mailto:raj@humanarchive.ai)

launches.title: Haladir: Building Operational Superintelligence
launches.tagline: Combining formal solvers with LLMs to make AI reliable for high-stakes operational decisions
launches.detail_body:
**TL;DR:** Haladir is an AI product lab that combines formal solvers with LLMs to make AI reliable for constrained systems. We turn unreliable model outputs into **verifiable, optimal decisions** for industries like **logistics, critical software, and manufacturing**. We are working with one of the leading AI labs to bring our technology to post-training.

**Launch Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=caPPFAmL8Iw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=caPPFAmL8Iw)**

**The Problem**

Operationally-complex companies (logistics, supply chain, etc.) need to make thousands of decisions a day under tight, real-world constraints. Even when given ample context, we observe that the top models often fail to understand these constraints when placed in difficult scenarios, providing suboptimal or confidently incorrect responses. Though they excel at individual tasks like coding and data analysis, optimizing across systems with millions of interdependent variables under hard constraints remains beyond what current models can do on their own.

**The Solution**

Haladir combines formal solvers with LLMs to give models a fundamental understanding of constraints rather than just semantic context. For logistics and supply chain companies, this means routing, scheduling, and resource allocation that AI can reason through rather than guess at.

We build at both the model training layer and the application layer. On the training side, we build solver-based RL environments and data pipelines for frontier labs. On the application side, we build model harnesses that allow deployed agents to operate within constrained, sensitive workflows and make optimal decisions. Decades of development in solvers like Gurobi and SAT/SMT have produced incredibly powerful technologies, but there's a growing gap between these tools and how AI is deployed today. We're here to close that gap.

Read our research: [haladir.com/research](http://haladir.com/research)

**The Team**

In high school, we published and were cited in IEEE and Elsevier Q1 journals for operations research and machine learning. We left Carnegie Mellon, Princeton, and UVA to build Haladir.

**Our Ask**

We'd love to talk with you if:

* You work at a logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing company where AI isn't yet delivering on real decision-making
* You work at or with frontier AI labs interested in solver-based training environments
* You know talented people in operations research, formal methods, or applied ML

_TL;DR — Valgo is the risk quantification layer for insurance of physical AI. Since historical claims data doesn’t exist for autonomy, we turn simulations into loss estimates that insurers need to price coverage._

<https://youtu.be/td2uzvldFPY>

Insurers face challenges pricing physical AI systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output simulated loss estimates that insurers need to price coverage. **Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk.**

**Team.** Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. [Sydney](https://www.linkedin.com/in/smkatz/) and [Robert](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robert-j-moss/) are Stanford PhDs who wrote the [textbook](https://algorithmsbook.com/validation) on validating safety-critical systems and teach the [course](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoROMvodv4rOq1LMLI8U7djzDb8--xpaC&si=G0EqPyi8SMDcQO3Q) at Stanford. launches.title: OpenSpec: The Spec Framework for Coding Agents
launches.tagline: 27k+ stars. The open-source spec layer for AI-assisted development
launches.detail_body:
Hey, everyone, I'm Tabish, and I’m the founder of [OpenSpec](https://openspec.dev/)!

**TL;DR:** OpenSpec is an open-source spec framework that captures what you're building, why, and how, before your coding agent writes a line of code. 27k+ GitHub stars in under six months.

[\[Launch Video\]](https://youtu.be/N-MftbmnmMo)

### The Problem

Generating code is now cheap. Correctness is still expensive.

Engineers don't distrust AI-generated code because models aren't capable. They distrust it because they can't reliably get the output they actually wanted. Did the agent meet my requirements? Handle edge cases? Fit my architecture?

The bottleneck isn't the model. It's underspecification.

### How It Works

OpenSpec adds a spec layer to your codebase: an openspec/ folder in your repo with two parts.

**A spec library** (openspec/specs/) that documents how your system actually works, organized by capability. Living documentation that your agents and your team can always reference.

**A changes system** (openspec/changes/) where each feature you build gets a proposal, design, implementation tasks, and spec deltas showing exactly how the requirements will change. When you ship, the deltas merge back into the spec library, so it grows with your codebase.

Everything is markdown. Checkable into Git. Always accessible by your coding agent. We provide integrations with 20+ AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and more) so your agents help you create, evolve, and manage specs through slash commands and skills.

* **Your thinking persists.** Unlike plan mode, specs don't vanish when you close the chat.
* **Iterate across sessions.** Evolve specs, keep the context.
* **Changes are cheap here.** Expensive in code.

We're seeing teams shift from code review to _plan review_. It's easier to read a markdown spec than a large diff, and writing one forces real thought about the problem.

### Backstory

I was a team lead at a quantum computing startup. Turns out, managing coding agents is a lot like managing a team. Things break when there's no alignment on what you're building and why. Coding agents can't read your mind. That's still your job. We're building the workspace where that job gets done.

### Ask

**If your team has adopted AI coding tools but you're finding it harder to stay aligned, that's exactly the problem we're solving.** Code review feels heavier, agents produce work that doesn't quite fit, and your codebase is changing faster than anyone can track.

* **Try it yourself:** OpenSpec takes less than a minute to set up. Use it on your next feature: [github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)
* **Engineering teams working on large or multi-repo codebases:** We're building Workspaces for teams that need deeper collaboration, customization, and multi-repo planning. If that sounds like you, we want to build it with you. Reach out at [tabish@openspec.dev](mailto:tabish@openspec.dev).
* **Know an eng lead figuring out how to make AI coding work across their team?** We'd love an intro.

**Website:** [openspec.dev](http://openspec.dev) **Email:** [tabish@openspec.dev](mailto:tabish@openspec.dev)

We capture real human behavior in highly controlled settings and turn judgment, taste, and long-horizon reasoning into high-fidelity environments for frontier models.

Reinforcement learning has already helped frontier models achieve superhuman ability in math and coding since these domains have very clean and deterministic feedback loops.

We are building data factories to create high fidelity real life work environments at scale.

launches.title: Carrot Labs: Custom models tuned to your tasks that never stop improving
launches.tagline: Your model is your moat. Stop renting your intelligence and start growing it.
launches.detail_body:
**TL;DR:** Carrot Labs helps you build models for your agents that are faster and better, forever. Use our platform to build proprietary models using open source that progressively improve.

[**Our Launch Video**](https://youtu.be/Qiw-HG14AVE)

## **The Problems:**

Frontier models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are constantly pushing the boundary of intelligence further, but great quality comes with high latency and cost. Smaller models are fast, but can't get the job done right.

So you start modifying system prompts. It takes you far enough, but at some point you hit a ceiling. And every time a new model comes out, your prompts don't work the same way anymore! (just February 2026 alone, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 from Anthropic, Gemini 3.1 Pro from Google, GPT-5.3-Codex from Open AI, Qwen 3.5 from Alibaba came out to name a few.)

## **Solution:**

We build you a proprietary model tuned to your tasks so you always have access to the most performant model for your agent.

Our platform records your agent’s activity and tunes an optimized model from an open source base model. Once it's ready, swap out the frontier model for yours. That's it. As new production data flows in, we continuously evaluate and retrain your model to boost performance. What you get is a model specialized to your tasks that outperforms frontier.

## **Why this matters to your startup:**

In the short run, you need your agent to be faster and more accurate, and prompt tuning will only get you so far. We are the fastest way to get there.

In the long run, every company building agents is using the same frontier models. Your competitor has the same intelligence you do. The thing that differentiates you is the knowledge you distill into your own model. Your model is your moat.

## **Team:**

Chris led AI at Skylo Technologies, the world's largest commercial direct-to-device satellite network that provides satellite communications services to Google, Samsung, and Garmin devices.

Yuta was a senior data scientist at Snowflake where he developed financial forecasts through ML that supported the company's hypergrowth from pre-IPO to billions in revenue.

## **How you can help:**

If you are building agents or know anyone building agents who would appreciate a model that outperforms frontier on their tasks, let us know at [contact@carrotlabs.ai](mailto:contact@carrotlabs.ai).

Our self-serve agent eval SDKs are available. Feel free to use it! You can sign up from here: <https://platform.carrotlabs.ai/login>.

launches.title: Origami Robotics: Make AI to Learn Physical Skills Easier than Ever
launches.tagline: Robotic hand and Data Collection Device Designed for Robot Learning
launches.detail_body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98503&key=user_uploads/1760667/cab991fb-9782-494c-ac5d-e8c4d6263e58)

## **TL;DR**

Origami Robotics builds **high-DOF hand with in-joint motors** and co-designed data-collection glove that matches each other exactly. This eliminates embodiment gap, enabling us to collect real-world data and deploy it directly to the hardware.

We already sold our hands to Physical AI Labs like Amazon to push frontier of general manipulation further.

Video: <https://youtu.be/S8D1kfZfutI>

Hi, We are Daniel and Ryan.

During Daniel’s Phd’s period when he studied robot manipulation in CMU Robotics Institute, he has been kept run into the same wall. There are no existing robotic hand that is truly designed for learning, and a severe lack of high-quality manipulation data. The large transmission(Checkout Daniel’s [Dexterity Deadlocks](https://www.origami-robotics.com/blog/dexterity-deadlocks.html) Blog) often found in current robotic hands making dynamics of the hand extremely hard to model. And the embodiment gap(different kinematics, contacts, and sensing of the robotic and human hand) make the distribution of the data collected for training and real world deploying too large for any policy to pick up skills and do real useful tasks.

To solve this, Daniel teamed up with his brother Ryan, a fellow robot enthusiast and serial robotics entrepreneur. Together, Origami decided to build our own robotic hardware and find a way to scale up high-quality robotic data. By optimizing miniature motor design and co-designing our data-collection glove alongside our robotic hand, We minimized sim-real and embodiment gap that has been haunting the robotic research community. Now, we can scale up high-quality data collection for dexterous, real-world tasks.

With Origami Robotics’s Hand, you can enjoy the benefits of easily transferring learned skills from simulation to real-world scenarios. You can also leverage the thousands of hours of minimum-embodiment real data we’ve collected to train the exact manipulation policies you need.

**Let’s fold some origamis and a better future together!**

## **ASK**

Please like and share this post with anyone you think we should connect with, whether they are a robotics researcher or an industry professional looking for automation solutions. We would love to talk!

Email: founders@origami-robotics.com

launches.title: Eos AI - Autonomous OS for hospitals
launches.tagline: Our healthcare system is failing the people it’s supposed to serve. At Eos AI, we are fixing that.
launches.detail_body:
**TLDR:** We help hospitals turn their historical data into intelligence they can act on, catching operational and care breakdowns before they happen.

We create standardized data representations across all systems and time, retrieving similar trajectories to generate actionable forecasts so administrators and physicians can intervene early, save staff hours, and recover revenue.

**We are live (bless up!):**

In our early clinics, we are seeing \~3x productivity improvements in admin workflows and 37% revenue recovery by identifying early intervention points and automating operational workflows.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98511&key=user_uploads/1928939/beca5e3e-27f7-475a-ae9b-f639169912f2)

#feedourdoctors

Today, hospitals have more data than any other industry in the world, but only 3% has been utilized to inform care decisions. And this is because healthcare is one of the most fragmented systems _somehow_ still in play:

* a single patient’s data sits across EHRs, imaging systems, payer portals, specialty-specific software
* it exists in completely different formats and distributions
* and none of the systems can talk to each other

**So what’s the solution:** move the intelligence to the data

Eos acts as an intelligent hub that helps healthcare systems collate all their data across fragmented sources, and make intelligent predictions on top of it. We first harmonize data across all platforms to create a unified and standardized patient data distributions and timelines, acting like a translation layer between different applications. Then we build a centralized index over it: a compressed representation that lets petabytes of data stay where they are yet allows us to search and reason across it as one system.

<https://youtu.be/i4jSgAeSfMA>

**What this enables us to do:**

Instead of treating the visit or document as an isolated instance, Eos looks at the patient’s full history and compares it to thousands of similar patients over time. It predicts how a case will resolve, triggers the required approvals and actions, and does so while reducing staff workload and recovering hospital revenue.

**The team:**

I’m Arya, I studied Math and CS at Caltech and did a lot of clinical AI and bio research at Stanford and Caltech. As long as I can remember, I have always wanted to be a doctor to help people (cliché, I know, but true nonetheless!), and realized the best way to help as many people as possible is to build a tool that every doctor can use. And super excited to have Professor Kuo from Stanford on board as well!

**How you can help:**

We are looking to scale our early successes. If you know anyone who works at health systems or independent clinics, would greatly appreciate an introduction!

Cheers,\
Eos AI :)

launches.detail_body:
Building collaboration features from scratch is one of those problems that looks simple and isn't.

CRDT for live sync. Presence to show who's online. Comments that attach to specific elements. Notifications. Permissions. 

It compounds fast. Most teams either skip it or spend months on it and regret both decisions.

We've been building this infrastructure for 4 years. Varonis, Pendo, HeyGen, Freshworks, Trumpet already use it in production.

Today we're launching a Claude Code plugin that installs all of it in under 10 minutes.

You run one command. It asks which features you want. 

You give it your API key. It installs, configures, and wires everything together.

That's it.

→ Watch the demo: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JpfKRu65DTk>

→ Get started: <https://velt.dev/>

→ Docs: <https://docs.velt.dev/get-started/plugins>

We're a small team and we read every message. 

If you try it and something doesn't work, tell us.

Residential contractors juggle dozens of moving pieces — estimates, plans, takeoffs, proposals, change orders, documents — across spreadsheets, email threads, and sticky notes. Scout Out is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built specifically for construction, automating the busywork so contractors can focus on building.

[**Scout Out**](https://scoutout.ai/) contractors one platform to manage every job — with AI that handles takeoffs, clients, crew, and documents in minutes, not hours.\
\
**Ask:** If you know residential contractors, remodelers, or builders drowning in admin work, we'd love an intro.

👉 Contact us at: [nolan@scoutout.ai](mailto:nolan@scoutout.ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/30e770cd-ac0d-4853-9d5c-40b1cb0f9615)

# [**🕺**](https://emojipedia.org/man-dancing)**The Team**

[**Nolan (Founder & CEO)**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/) – triple majored in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Astrophysics, and Business Administration through UC Berkeley’s M.E.T. program, graduating in three years. He previously worked as a software development engineer at Amazon and ran a software consultancy he scaled to $250k in revenue. As a fourth-generation member of a family construction business, Nolan saw firsthand how difficult it is for contractors to consistently find new work — and how little time they have to sit down and bid on projects while managing active jobs. Scout Out was built to solve that problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/6d9cfed3-6baf-4fac-b9b7-ec2a2d99a6de)

# **❌ The Problem**

Residential contractors are running complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never built for construction.

* **Project management is fragmented.** Plans live in email. Estimates live in spreadsheets. Photos live on phones. Proposals get copy-pasted from old Word docs. Nothing talks to anything else.
* **Estimating is slow and error-prone.** Reading through plans, measuring takeoffs, pricing labor and materials, then assembling a professional proposal — this process takes hours and still produces mistakes. Contractors either underbid to win, or overbid to be safe, and lose anyway.
* **AI tools exist but aren't built for construction.** Generic project management software ignores the realities of field work — plan sets, per-page takeoffs, scope changes mid-build, subcontractor coordination.

  Contractors end up duct-taping tools together and paying the price in margin and stress.

**The result:** Jobs are won with incomplete bids, managed with ad-hoc systems, and closed with manual paperwork that eats hours contractors don't have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/0cdecb42-5772-4e1d-81d1-1d7fb87db86d)

# **🙌 Our Solution: One Platform for the Entire Job**

Scout Out is a single platform that handles the full lifecycle of a construction job — from first estimate to final invoice — with AI doing the heavy lifting.

### Job & Customer Hub 🏗️

Everything lives in one place, organized around the job:

* Customer records and full contact history
* All uploads in one place: plans, photos, permits, contracts, and insurance
* Status tracking across every deliverable and milestone
* Every conversation, change order, and document tied to the right job

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/ffbb3afc-3a3e-425d-800a-23c7fc95413a)

### Instant AI-Powered Bidding ⚡

When a contractor finds a project they want, ScoutOut generates a **clean, editable quote in seconds**.

* Upload plans, photos, or a short description
* AI produces a structured estimate covering scope, labor, and materials
* Contractors can review, adjust, and send a professional bid immediately

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/cf8c8b3c-0744-4b8b-b092-16e0952bf102)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

* No long setup or training
* Quotes are editable and contractor-owned
* Built to be used between site visits, calls, and active builds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/f723d694-6721-4b5a-a80a-4bd39e691892)

**TL;DR**

SpotPay is a global neobank that lets people spend, send and receive money anywhere in the world from a single account.

We’re building the next generation of financial services powered by modern blockchains and stablecoin technology.

<https://youtu.be/lnUMKwfnmvQ>

And SpotPay is taking off! 🚀🚀

We launched just over two months ago and today we’re already **live in 40+ countries**. On average, our TPV (Total Payment Volume) is growing **43% week over week**, and our user base is growing **27% week over week**. Along the way we’ve sat down with **country leaders, large companies and central bank governors** – all sharing a common excitement around SpotPay and the future of global payments. We’re just getting started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98487&key=user_uploads/2963544/30c07567-701e-4b46-a7ff-a7d61fffc8aa)

**Hey, we’re Zsika and Thomas.**

We kept noticing the same thing through our lived experience. Modern financial tools continue to feel like a privilege reserved for the rich world. Even with the recent increase in remittance providers, most “innovation” simply stops at the sender side — while the receiver is still stuck with legacy ways of collecting, spending, and managing money.

So we’re building SpotPay to change that.

* SpotPay provides every user with a **verified wallet** that’s tied to their real identity. That foundation lets us issue a **SpotPay Credit Card** and integrate seamlessly with **Apple Pay / Google Pay** — even for users who don’t have a bank account in their home country.
* SpotPay also allows merchants to **accept QR code payments** – avoiding the high card processing fees and gaining access to instant payment settlements since all SpotPay payments are settled on the blockchain. For SMBs, instant settlement often means they can utilize revenue from their sales up to **24 hours faster** than they would using traditional finance and maintain healthy cash flows as a result.

**Who is SpotPay for?**

Everyone.

We believe everyone deserves access to modern financial tools — **especially the hundreds of millions** of people around the world who are still unbanked or underbanked.

Because SpotPay verifies each user with their real identity, you **do not need a traditional bank account to use it**.

Imagine sending money to your aunt in another country, and within seconds she can tap her phone to pay for coffee at a local café.

Now imagine this and countless similar scenarios multiplied across 40+ countries around the world. These are the kinds of early use cases we are already seeing.

We believe that a person’s financial life should not depend on where they live, or what banking system they happen to inherit. We’re building SpotPay to make modern money a reality for everyone, everywhere.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98487&key=user_uploads/2963544/2f7bcb62-c7e0-49c8-93d3-bae98ef6c830)

**About Us:**

**Zsika** previously worked as a tech lead and PM at **Google** on several products including **YouTube Monetization, Ads Monetization, and Google Cloud**. Zsika grew up between the Caribbean and Mexico so the solution SpotPay is building is very close to him.

**Thomas** was engineer #4 at **Brex**, where he was most recently a Principal Engineer. He has spent years building financial products and infrastructure at scale. Thomas also worked as a Software Engineer at **Google**.

**How you can help:**

📱 **Download SpotPay today!** — there’s a good chance we already support the country you’re from and the country you live in, even if those are different places :).

💬 Share this with anyone who travels, sends money internationally, or receives money across borders.

🌍 Tell us the countries where you’d like to see SpotPay next.

Download here:\
<https://join.spotpay.ai>

From SpotPay with 💜

# Valence - The Trading Superapp for Prediction Markets 📈

Trade across every prediction market from one interface

**Neo, Daniel, Arthur**

[Valence](https://valence.trade/)

---

Hey YC! We're **Neo**, **Daniel**, and **Arthur** from Valence and we're building the trading superapp for prediction markets. We sit across all the exchanges and provide customizable trading terminals, APIs, data, and execution. Our software works for both individuals and teams.

**Over 1B contracts have been traded through our platform.**

🔗 [valence.trade](http://valence.trade)

**Ask:** Building or trading in prediction markets? We'd love to hear from you: [**founders@valence.trade**](mailto:founders@valence.trade)

---

# TL;DR

Valence is one interface for every prediction market. Trade across Kalshi, Polymarket, and [**Crypto.com**](http://Crypto.com) with one unified orderbook. Monitor P&L, risk, balances, and positions across all exchanges in one spot. Use our API to write strategies that integrate with our global interface.

---

# Problem ❌

**Fragmented liquidity:** With more exchanges appearing faster than ever, liquidity becomes more scattered. This creates market inefficiencies for traders. With variable fee structures, rules, and settlement risks across multiple markets, execution becomes less about "what is correct" and more about managing multiple interfaces, inconsistent risks, and higher time-to-trade.

**Underdeveloped tooling:** Most exchanges are not focused on providing great trading infrastructure, since most users are retail-focused. This creates a major barrier for serious traders and teams trying to enter or scale in the space. Valence fills this gap — we provide the trading terminals, APIs, and execution infrastructure that the exchanges themselves don't. Instead of building the same connectors and infrastructure for every exchange, traders can execute across all platforms with one click and focus on what actually matters: trading.

**No unified data layer:** There is a lack of fundamental things like data and matching identical markets across multiple platforms. With Valence's API and verification process, traders can determine which tickers are the same, and use one API to access every platform, backtest, and run in production. With full access to historical data and proprietary datasets, Valence already powers the very highest volume traders on some of these exchanges.

---

# Solution ✅

The setup process to trade across dif

ferent exchanges is annoying, and oftentimes traders find themselves writing the same infrastructure. Valence offers a web-based terminal and APIs to provide a frictionless experience to trade across infinite exchanges, with unified views. We support both systematic and manual trading — also at the same time.

**Valence Terminal**

* Unified orderbook across all exchanges — see every venue in one view
* Smart routing to get you the cheapest contracts across all venues
* Live monitoring of all P&L, risk, balances, and positions
* Fast click-trading with built-in data feeds
* Automated trading assistance — detect potentially harmful situations and cancel orders

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98484&key=user_uploads/1419388/9bfacd69-145c-4b93-b11a-f81471653366)


**Valence API for Developers**

* Connect once, trade everywhere — one standardized API across every exchange
* Cross-platform ticker matching so you always know when two exchanges list the same market
* Full historical data and proprietary datasets for backtesting
* Build and deploy your own strategies with template engines and custom services

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98484&key=user_uploads/1419388/e8f60f0e-b2ac-4607-ac50-39b68530306b)

**Discovery**

* Find opportunities across platforms you might not even be watching
* Access proprietary datasets across sports, politics, and more

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98484&key=user_uploads/1419388/7366a047-e13e-45ea-a43f-e860b1da1f3b)

---

# Traction 📊

Over **1B contracts** traded through our platform. We grew from 7M contracts in September to 250M in December 2025 — nearly **30× in four months**.

Prominent traders (top 3) on the Kalshi public leaderboard uses Valence, trading over 100M contracts a month on our platform. We've helped another team **scale their P&L by 5×** simply by enabling them to take more trades and source more liquidity.

Our users consistently see **200%+ month-over-month volume/profit growth** after switching to Valence.

---

# Who This Is For 💬

**Active prediction market traders** — You're tired of juggling tabs across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other exchanges. You want one place to see everything and execute everywhere.

**Systematic / algo traders** — You're building strategies and need a reliable API that works across every exchange without writing separate connectors for each one.

**Trading teams** — You want a shared interface where your team can collaborate, monitor positions, and trade together.

**Curious about prediction markets** — You've been interested but the fragmented UX and lack of tooling has kept you out. Valence makes it easy to get started.

If any of this is you, reach out: [**founders@valence.trade**](mailto:founders@valence.trade)

---

# Team 🧑‍💻

**Neo** previously interned at Citadel Securities as a quantitative developer, and also at DRW and Cubist Systematic Strategies on strategy and research efforts. Neo was also a former director of the USACO Guide (\~100K users, 1700+ GitHub stars).

**Arthur** interned twice at Jane Street as a trading intern, working on research projects involving monetization improvements. He represented the United States at international Bridge competitions and qualified for USAMO (top 250) and was a USACO Platinum Competitor. He can also get over 180 in Zetamac!

**Daniel** interned at IMC Trading and Citadel in both hardware and software engineering, and at ARM on systems research. He designed an ethernet MAC that outperforms IEEE specifications and contributed to the CXL specification at ARM.

---

**Try Valence → [valence.trade](http://valence.trade)**

---

* Recognize the opportunities for automation
* Describe your exact workflow in a prompt
* Learn new interfaces and configure new tools

So despite having "AI assistants," people are still spending hours on repetitive work that could be automated… if only custom AI tools could build themselves.

Traditional AI waits for you to describe what you need. Cofia proactively builds personalized automations, trained on _your_ exact workflows, by securely processing the work you actually do.

* Cofia learns about the specific repetitive tasks you do

launches.detail_body:
**TL;DR:** Outship is a recruiting platform that records and analyzes how engineering candidates use coding agents. Import a task repo from GitHub and send an invite link for a take home or an interview. We spin up a cloud workspace for them to work in.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98459&key=user_uploads/979984/e030f7b7-7cf7-4d83-bcd3-402c750994d0)

# ⁉️ Why?

Everyone’s feeling the AGI when it comes to coding. We spoke with over 50 YC teams in the past few weeks, and almost all of them are aggressively using coding agents to build product.

This naturally means that the skills that differentiate an okay engineer from an amazing one have changed significantly! Teams are no longer hiring for typing out code character by character. Instead, they need ambitious builders who can leverage the latest tools and techniques to achieve in a day what a team of five used to achieve in a week.

* “I usually ask them which agent they are using. If it’s still Cursor, I’ll send them to the bottom of the queue” – YC founder 🤵
* “If they know the latest stuff like a Ralph loop, that’s usually a really good sign that they are passionate” – another YC founder 💁‍♀️

Seeing a candidate work with AI can give you a lot of signal about their thought process and whether they’re the engineer you’re looking for.

The YC application, along with several companies, now asks applicants to attach AI agent sessions:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98459&key=user_uploads/979984/93653791-8e34-4aaa-a2c5-d5f9ceec3de2)

## 💩 Existing hiring tools can’t capture this

Tools like CoderPad and HackerRank have tried to band-aid a “AI Agent” on their Leetcode interview platforms, but honestly, these toy environments and their crappy GPT wrappers have nothing to do with how your engineers work today.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98459&key=user_uploads/979984/ad12a850-2927-42ae-a154-71ebb0394c61)

# 🚀 The Solution

We’ve built a platform to send tasks to candidates and record how they work on them with coding agents. We then analyze their implementation and coding agent sessions against customizable rubrics.

<https://youtu.be/VTZ_UZ52imY>

Outship spins up a cloud VM and drops the candidate into a browser based VS Code workspace with coding agents ready to use. They get a real remote machine: they can use the terminal, run web apps, forward ports, and more!

We handle the environment setup and secrets management so you can evaluate candidates on a level playing field.

# 🦞 Our Ask

1. If you are hiring engineers, try [outship.ai](https://outship.ai/)! I will personally help you get set up. (in person in SF Bay Area or over Zoom elsewhere)
2. If you want to chat more, book a meeting: [cal.com/saner/outship](https://cal.com/saner/outship?overlayCalendar=true)

We're [Bobby](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bobby-zhong/) and [Kurt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kartavya-sharma/), co-founders of Burt (W26).

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jj7XKdMwE1Q ](https://youtu.be/Jj7XKdMwE1Q)

## **TL;DR**

We help freight brokers and forwarders build AI teammates that handle their repetitive, manual tasks so teams have time to focus on customers, carriers, and growing the business.

Whether it’s tracking loads or chasing and processing documents, teams can build AI coworkers that follow their specific processes and work on top of their existing systems.

## **The Problem**

Freight brokers and forwarders operate on razor-thin margins in a relationship-driven business — yet most of their teams spend the majority of their day on manual, repetitive work.

Problems like

* **Shipment tracking and check calls**
* **Document processing and data entry**
* **Chasing PODs and rate cons**
* **Finding and booking carriers**
* **Invoice auditing and billing reconciliation**
* **Quoting and building loads**

As volume grows, so does the headcount required to manage it. Teams burn out, service suffers, and growth stalls.

## **Our Solution**

We help freight brokers and forwarders build AI teammates that handle their most repetitive workflows end-to-end — check calls, document processing, covering loads, invoicing, and more — pulling in the right person only when they're actually needed.

Our AI teammates work the way a human operator would: reading emails, making calls, logging into portals, and updating their TMS — following their specific processes and living on top of their existing systems

Teams can take on more business without burning people out, cut down on costly mistakes, and get their best operators back on the relationships that actually drive growth.
